sans.value: Inter, -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, 'Segoe UI', 'Noto Sans', Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif, 'Apple Color Emoji', 'Segoe UI Emoji'
sans.comment: Interface and body type. Inter is self-hosted by @crewlethq/tokens/css/fonts; the system stack covers the moment before it loads and any app that does not import that stylesheet.

display.comment: Headings and other display type. An alias of the sans family, so a heading costs no extra download. Components keep reading this role token so a dedicated display face would land in one place.

mono.value: 'JetBrains Mono', ui-monospace, SFMono-Regular, 'SF Mono', Menlo, Consolas, 'Liberation Mono', monospace
mono.comment: Code, identifiers and tabular values. JetBrains Mono is self-hosted by @crewlethq/tokens/css/fonts.

2xs.comment: Micro labels and table column heads.

compact.comment: Table cells and captions. It sits between xs and sm rather than extending the ramp at either end, so it is named for its job.

tight.comment: Display sizes tighten, body sits at zero, micro labels open up. Declared once, so a heading and a caption cannot drift into six tracking values across six selectors.
